fiveMapGate.notes: The final product source state passed map/depth, topology, teardown, profiler, viewer, and PVS lifecycle gates.

concurrentAttempt.result: One build failed with CS2012 because both processes wrote the shared Content.Shared Release output.
concurrentAttempt.resolution: The required gates were rerun sequentially with shared compilation disabled and both passed.

focusedIntegrationAndSandbox.sandbox: Robust checked both client and shared content assemblies.

clientServerStability.knownNoise: After the client requested graceful shutdown, the pre-existing RMC Mentor disconnect handler tried to send MentorMessagesReceivedMsg to the disconnected channel and logged one server error. It did not terminate either process and is outside the Multi-Z paths changed here.

harnessChange.behavior: Construct redirected stdin with UTF-8 encoding without a preamble and write command bytes directly, preventing Windows PowerShell 5.1 from prefixing the first server-console command with a BOM.
harnessChange.validation: The final run accepted 'cmu_znet_stats arm' and captured the InGame milestone; no unknown-command or toolshed parse failure remained.

deferredRisks: The stability run used one local client. It is not a two-client authority, prediction, reconciliation, reconnect, or remote-camera trial.
The final no-lag stability run does not replace the earlier 100 ms connection/state-application capture and neither capture drove a production vehicle over an edge.
The current client-render evidence has CPU/frame/allocation distributions but no isolated GPU timestamps; blur and multi-depth compositing remain behavior-preserving GPU work only.
Populated-round packet distributions, repeated controlled late joins, production vehicle/ordnance actors, topology mapping bursts, and long live rounds remain open.
The pre-existing Mentor disconnect-handler send-after-disconnect error remains visible on graceful client shutdown.
